name: Rend Mimicry
prerequisites: you have seen a creature use Rend or have identified a creature that has Rend in combat
text:
Requirements You have hit the same enemy with two consecutive melee Strikes that each dealt slashing damage.

---
Taking advantage of the brutal efficiency of hacking away at a target with two slashing attacks, you've mastered the art of punishing a foe caught between your slices. You deal ternary(gte(@actor.level,16,3,ternarygte(@actor.level,10,2,1)))d6 slashing damage to the target. This damage increases to 2d6 at 10th level and to 3d6 at 16th level.
